images.screen: A · −7층 — 소리로만 오는 일곱 살의 여름 저녁
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of a minimalist narrative elevator game where memories arrive only as sound. Near-total darkness. On the left a tall aged brass elevator button plate with screws and brushed grain, forty round brass buttons all labelled with minus floors from −1 to −40; the first six are pressed and dulled, −7 glows warm orange like an ember. On the right, the closed dark elevator doors with a faint warm hairline of light at the seam. Over the darkness, thin teal concentric sound rings pulse from two points to show where each sound comes from, with bracketed sound captions in teal and a large centred serif subtitle of a mother's voice line. A big elegant serif floor number top-right and small pill tags of earlier remembered floors at the bottom. Korean UI: "내려가는 곳", "−7", "일곱 살 · 여름". Quiet cinematic chiaroscuro, black, antique brass and pale teal, fine film grain, heavy vignette.

images.screen: B · −39층 — 마지막 층 직전, 병실의 소리
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of the final moment of a minimalist narrative elevator game. The brass button plate on the left is now dimmed in shadow, every pressed button dark; only −39 glows orange and −40 glows pale white-blue like cold dawn. The elevator doors on the right have parted a finger's width and soft white light leaks through the vertical gap, blooming into the darkness. Slow wide pale concentric sound rings expand from the centre. A bracketed sound caption describes a slowing heart monitor, and a large centred serif subtitle carries a daughter's voice line. A thin white ECG trace runs across the bottom with widely spaced beats, beside small tags of remembered floors and a glowing pill button inviting the last press. Korean UI: "−39", "마지막 층", "딸". Tender and hushed, black with cold silver-blue light and one warm amber accent, film grain, vignette. The remembered-floor tags read exactly "−7 일곱 살 · 여름", "−24 스물네 살", "−31 딸이 태어난 날", "−39 병실"; each floor number is the age at that memory.
